mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO points_bucket (bucket_id, user_id, amount, remain, expire_at, reason_type, ref_id, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{bucketId}, #{userId}, #{amount}, #{remain}, #{expireAt}, #{reasonType}, #{refId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, bucket_id, user_id, amount, remain, expire_at, reason_type, ref_id, create_time, update_time FROM points_bucket WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND remain > 0 AND expire_at > NOW() ORDER BY expire_at ASC, id ASC FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE points_bucket SET remain = 0, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND remain > 0 AND bucket_id IN #{bucketId}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(remain), 0) FROM points_bucket WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND remain > 0 AND expire_at > NOW()

SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS bucketCount, SUM(remain) AS total FROM points_bucket WHERE remain > 0 AND expire_at > NOW() AND remain <= 10 GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY user_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, bucket_id, user_id, amount, remain, expire_at, reason_type, ref_id, create_time, update_time FROM points_bucket WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND remain > 0 AND expire_at > NOW() AND remain <= 10 ORDER BY expire_at ASC, id ASC FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, direction, amount, reason_type, ref_id, created_at, expire_at FROM ( SELECT id, 'IN' AS direction, amount, reason_type, ref_id, create_time AS created_at, expire_at FROM points_bucket WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND reason_type != 'COMPACTION' UNION ALL SELECT id, 'OUT' AS direction, amount, reason_type, ref_id, create_time AS created_at, NULL AS expire_at FROM points_detail WHERE user_id = #{userId} ) merged ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM points_bucket WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND reason_type != 'COMPACTION') + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM points_detail WHERE user_id = #{userId})
